st.headline: Payment firms Visa, Mastercard and Ant International team up on AI agent trust framework
st.teaser: The framework aims to help card networks, wallets and online marketplaces spot trusted AI agents.
fullText: SINGAPORE - Ant International, Mastercard and Visa have launched an initiative to develop common standards to identify and verify artificial intelligence (AI) agents that can make purchases on behalf of users .

The companies said on Sept 10 that they had begun collaborating on a Know-Your-Agent interoperability framework that would allow card networks, digital wallets, agent platforms and online marketplaces to recognise trusted AI agents across different payment ecosystems, while maintaining their own approval and risk-management processes.

The initiative comes as the payments industry prepares for the growth of agentic global consumer commerce, in which AI agents evolve from making recommendations to completing purchases on behalf of users.
The framework builds on the companies’ existing protocols, including Visa’s Trusted Agent Protocol, Mastercard Verifiable Intent and Ant International’s Agentic Mobile Protocol.
The companies said the initiative could help reduce integration costs and accelerate the launch of new agentic services by providing greater trust and risk visibility across participating networks.

Ant International, Mastercard and Visa said they would collaborate through BuildFin.ai, a platform convened by the Monetary Authority of Singapore that brings together financial institutions, technology providers and researchers to develop AI solutions for financial services. REUTERS

cna.headline: Singapore parliament debates changes to political salary framework
cna.teaser: The changes include a one-off pay increase of up to 9 per cent for political office holders and wider salary ranges for ministers.
fullText: SINGAPORE: Debate is underway in parliament on changes to Singapore's political salary framework , including pay adjustments for political office holders and higher allowances for MPs.

The debate on Thursday (Sep 10) comes two days after Prime Minister Lawrence Wong and Coordinating Minister for Public Services Chan Chun Sing set out the government's response to an independent review of the framework.
Political office holders will receive a one-off salary increase of up to 9 per cent from Oct 15, while MPs' monthly allowances will rise from S$13,750 to S$18,500.

listening.title: Singapore's Green Transition in Public Transport
listening.transcript: Singapore is rapidly pushing to electrify its public bus fleet by 2040, aiming to replace half of its diesel buses with cleaner electric alternatives by 2030. Commuters will soon experience quieter rides and significantly reduced carbon emissions during their daily journeys. To support this transition, new charging infrastructure is being installed at key bus depots across the island.

economistArticle.title: The Gravity of Yields: What India's Bond Inclusion Reveals About Global Capital
paras: For months, global bond markets have experienced a relentless sell-off, pushing yields to levels unseen in over a decade. As central banks worldwide signal that interest rates will remain elevated to combat persistent inflation, investors are reassessing the risk profiles of traditional safe havens. Amid this turmoil, emerging markets are no longer merely passive victims of capital flight; instead, they are carving out new avenues of fortitude.

India's recent inclusion in major global emerging-market bond indices serves as a compelling case study. Historically, international investors viewed Indian government debt with caution, deterred by capital controls and bureaucratic hurdles. However, the decision by index providers to include sovereign rupee bonds has triggered a structural shift, drawing billions of dollars of foreign capital into the subcontinent's domestic debt market.

This influx highlights a broader divergence in how investors perceive fiscal stability. While fiscal deficits in the West continue to swell without immediate remedies, emerging economies are demonstrating rigorous monetary discipline. India's inclusion is not just an administrative milestone; it represents a fundamental realignment, offering global asset managers a crucial buffer against the volatility of US Treasuries.

Yet, this integration is a double-edged sword that exposes domestic markets to global headwinds. As foreign capital floods in, Indian policymakers must navigate the delicate balance of maintaining exchange-rate stability while keeping domestic borrowing costs manageable. The global bond sell-off suggests that yield differentials are no longer the sole driver of capital; structural reliability and fiscal prudence now dictate the flow of international finance.

Ultimately, the evolving dynamics of the global debt market underscore a transition from a unipolar financial system to a more fragmented landscape. Investors seeking shelter from fluctuating yields are finding that emerging markets, once considered volatile outposts, now offer indispensable stability. As the global bond sell-off persists, the lessons from India's index inclusion may well rewrite the playbook for international portfolio diversification.
economistArticle.cn:
几个月来，全球债券市场经历了无情的抛售，将收益率推至十多年未见的水平。随着全球央行发出信号，表示将维持高利率以对抗持续的通货膨胀，投资者正在重新评估传统避险资产的风险状况。在这场动荡中，新兴市场不再仅仅是资本外流的被动受害者；相反，它们正在开辟出新的坚韧之路。

印度近期被纳入主要的全球新兴市场债券指数，提供了一个引人注目的案例。从历史上看，受资本管制和官僚障碍的阻碍，国际投资者对印度政府债务一直持谨慎态度。然而，指数提供商将主权卢比债券纳入其中的决定引发了结构性转变，吸引了数十亿美元的外资流入这一次大陆的国内债务市场。

这种流入突显了投资者对财政稳定性的看法存在更广泛的分歧。在西方财政赤字持续膨胀且缺乏即时补救措施的同时，新兴经济体则展现出了严格的货币纪律。印度的加入不仅是一个行政里程碑，更代表了一次根本性的重新调整，为全球资产配置者提供了抵御美债波动的重要缓冲。

然而，这种融合是一把双刃剑，使国内市场暴露在全球逆风之中。随着外资涌入，印度政策制定者必须在维持汇率稳定和保持国内借贷成本可控之间寻求微妙的平衡。全球债券抛售表明，收益率差异不再是资本的唯一驱动力；结构性可靠性和财政审慎如今决定着国际资金的流向。

归根结底，全球债务市场不断变化的动态凸显了金融体系正从单极走向更加多元零散的格局。在试图规避波动收益率的投资者发现，曾经被视为动荡前沿的新兴市场，如今提供了不可或缺的稳定。在全球债券抛售持续的背景下，印度被纳入指数的经验很可能会重写国际投资组合多元化的游戏规则。

gems.why: This sentence uses a 'While...' adverbial clause to establish a sharp, sophisticated contrast between Western fiscal issues and emerging market discipline. In Chinese: 这句话使用以 'While...' 开头的状语从句，在西方财政赤字问题与新兴市场的自律之间建立起鲜明而高级的对比。
